headline: Khaitan & Co advises DBS Bank on $24 million acquisition financing extended to Delhi International Cargo Terminal
sum: DBS Bank Limited, GIFT City Branch has extended a $24 million ECB acquisition financing to Delhi International Cargo Terminal Private Limited for the acquisition of KSH Distribution Private Limited. Khaitan & Co advised DBS Bank on this…
detail: DBS Bank Limited, GIFT City Branch has extended a $24 million ECB acquisition financing to Delhi International Cargo Terminal Private Limited for the acquisition of KSH Distribution Private Limited. Khaitan & Co advised DBS Bank on this financing deal. The transaction was led by Mohit Nad (Counsel), with Akshansh Sharma (Senior Associate) and Aparna Arya (Senior Associate), under the strategic guidance of Manisha Shroff (Partner). This transaction is one of the few acquisition-financing structures successfully implemented under the ECB framework following the liberalisation introduced by the 2026 ECB amendments.
